```{r load_utils, include=FALSE}
# =============================================================================
# file_utils.R
#
# A unified toolkit for caching and saving R objects, tables, and figures.
#
# Design decisions
# ----------------
#   1. Complex objects (DGEList, EList, list-of-lists, model fits, …) must use
#      .rds. Attempting .csv / .tsv with a non-flat object errors immediately.
#
#   2. Figures are cached too. If the output file already exists and
#      overwrite = FALSE, ggsave is skipped entirely.
#
#   3. The compute block can be passed as either:
#        a bare { } expression  →  cache(path, { ... })
#        a lambda / function    →  cache(path, function() { ... })
#                                  cache(path, \() { ... })          # R 4.1+
#      Both are detected and handled automatically.
#
#   4. File naming is always:  dir/project_analysis.ext
#      Use make_path(project, analysis, ext, dir) to build paths consistently,
#      then pass the result into cache(), save_figures(), or cache_with_figures().
#
# Core API
# --------
#   make_path()           Build a consistent path: dir/project_analysis.ext
#                         Pass multiple ext values to get multiple paths at once.
#
#   cache()               Load if cached, otherwise compute + save.
#                         Extension determines format:
#                           .rds          → any R object
#                           .csv / .tsv   → data.frame / tibble only
#
#   save_figures()        Save ggplot / patchwork to one or more files.
#                         Skips files that already exist (overwrite = FALSE).
#
#   cache_with_figures()  One compute block → caches data + saves figures.
#                         Block must return list(data = …, plot = …).
#
#   safe_filename()       Low-level collision-safe path builder.
#
# Quick reference
# ---------------
#
#   ## Build paths with make_path() ────────────────────────────────────────────
#   #   Single path
#   make_path(project, "voom_clean",  "rds",        dirDataclean)
#   #   → "DataClean/P01_voom_clean.rds"
#
#   #   Multiple extensions at once (returns named character vector)
#   make_path(project, "results",     c("csv","rds"), dirResults)
#   #   → c(csv = "Results/P01_results.csv", rds = "Results/P01_results.rds")
#
#   #   Mix data + figure paths for cache_with_figures()
#   make_path(project, "pca",         c("pdf","png"), dirFigs)
#   #   → c(pdf = "Figs/P01_pca.pdf", png = "Figs/P01_pca.png")
#
#   ## Any complex object (DGEList, EList, list-of-lists) ─────────────────────
#   dat.voom_clean <- cache(
#     make_path(project, "voom_clean", "rds", dirDataclean),
#     {
#       libs <- dat.voom$targets %>%
#         subset(visit %notin% c("?", "Unknown")) %>%
#         pull(libid)
#       tmp <- dat.voom[, libs]
#       tmp$targets <- tmp$targets %>%
#         mutate(visit = ifelse(visit == "Screening/Enrollment", "Screening", visit)) %>%
#         mutate(visit = factor(visit,
#                  levels = c("Screening", "Cold A Clinic", "Cold B Home", "Visit 1")))
#       tmp     # ← last expression is what gets cached
#     }
#   )
#
#   ## Same thing with a lambda ────────────────────────────────────────────────
#   dat.voom_clean <- cache(
#     make_path(project, "voom_clean", "rds", dirDataclean),
#     function() {
#       ...
#       tmp
#     }
#   )
#
#   ## Flat table → csv AND rds simultaneously ─────────────────────────────────
#   results_tbl <- cache(
#     make_path(project, "results", c("csv", "rds"), dirResults),
#     { compute_results(dat.voom_clean) }
#   )
#
#   ## Figures only (skips if files already exist) ─────────────────────────────
#   save_figures(
#     p_pca,
#     paths = make_path(project, "pca", c("pdf", "png"), dirFigs),
#     width = 8, height = 6
#   )
#
#   ## Data + figures in one call ──────────────────────────────────────────────
#   dat.voom_clean <- cache_with_figures(
#     data_paths   = make_path(project, "voom_clean",  "rds",          dirDataclean),
#     figure_paths = make_path(project, "pca",         c("pdf", "png"), dirFigs),
#     width = 8, height = 6,
#     {
#       obj <- build_voom(dat.raw)
#       list(data = obj, plot = plot_pca(obj))
#     }
#   )
#
# =============================================================================


# ── internal constants & helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────

.figure_exts <- c("pdf", "png", "svg", "eps", "tiff", "jpeg", "jpg")
.table_exts  <- c("csv", "tsv")
.rds_exts    <- "rds"
.all_exts    <- c(.rds_exts, .table_exts, .figure_exts)

.ext <- function(path) tolower(tools::file_ext(path))

.ensure_dir <- function(path) {
  d <- dirname(path)
  if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  invisible(d)
}

.is_flat <- function(x) is.data.frame(x) || isTRUE(inherits(x, "tbl"))

# Null-coalescing (avoids rlang dependency)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

# Resolve expr: works for bare { } blocks and function() / \() lambdas.
# Always evaluated in the caller's parent frame so variables are in scope.
.resolve_expr <- function(expr, env) {
  if (is.function(expr)) {
    expr()                        # lambda: call it
  } else {
    eval(expr, envir = env)       # bare block: evaluate in caller's frame
  }
}



# ── make_path ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#' Build a consistent file path: dir/project_analysis.ext
#'
#' The single source of truth for file naming across your project. Always
#' produces paths of the form \code{dir/project_analysis.ext}.
#'
#' When \code{ext} is a vector, one path is returned per extension, named by
#' extension. This makes it easy to pass multiple formats to \code{cache()},
#' \code{save_figures()}, or \code{cache_with_figures()} in one call.
#'
#' @param project   character  Project identifier (e.g. \code{"P01"} or
#'                             \code{projectNumber_swab}).
#' @param analysis  character  Descriptive analysis label
#'                             (e.g. \code{"voom_clean"}, \code{"pca"}).
#' @param ext       character  One or more extensions without a leading dot
#'                             (e.g. \code{"rds"}, \code{c("csv","rds")},
#'                             \code{c("pdf","png")}).
#' @param dir       character  Target directory. Created if it does not exist.
#' @return A named character vector of normalised paths, one per extension.
#'         If only one extension is supplied the vector is unnamed.
#'
#' @examples
#' \dontrun{
#' ## Single path
#' make_path(project, "voom_clean", "rds", dirDataclean)
#' # "DataClean/P01_voom_clean.rds"
#'
#' ## Multiple extensions at once
#' make_path(project, "results", c("csv", "rds"), dirResults)
#' # c(csv = "Results/P01_results.csv", rds = "Results/P01_results.rds")
#'
#' ## Pass directly into cache()
#' dat <- cache(
#'   make_path(project, "voom_clean", "rds", dirDataclean),
#'   { build_voom(dat.raw) }
#' )
#'
#' ## Pass directly into save_figures()
#' save_figures(p_pca,
#'   make_path(project, "pca", c("pdf", "png"), dirFigs),
#'   width = 8, height = 6)
#'
#' ## Both at once via cache_with_figures()
#' dat <- cache_with_figures(
#'   data_paths   = make_path(project, "voom_clean",  "rds",          dirDataclean),
#'   figure_paths = make_path(project, "pca",         c("pdf", "png"), dirFigs),
#'   width = 8, height = 6,
#'   { list(data = build_voom(dat.raw), plot = plot_pca(obj)) }
#' )
#' }
#' @export
make_path <- function(project, analysis, ext, dir) {
  project  <- as.character(project)
  analysis <- as.character(analysis)
  dir      <- as.character(dir)

  if (!dir.exists(dir)) dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  base  <- paste0(project, "_", analysis)
  paths <- normalizePath(
    file.path(dir, paste0(base, ".", ext)),
    winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE
  )

  # Name by extension when multiple are given; leave unnamed for a single ext
  if (length(ext) > 1L) stats::setNames(paths, ext) else paths
}

# ── safe_filename ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#' Build a collision-safe file path
#'
#' Creates the parent directory if needed and returns a path that will not
#' silently overwrite an existing file (unless \code{overwrite = TRUE}).
#'
#' @param dir       character  Target directory.
#' @param basename  character  Base name; any extension is stripped and
#'                             replaced by \code{ext}.
#' @param ext       character  Extension without leading dot (e.g. \code{"rds"}).
#' @param overwrite logical    If TRUE return the plain path even if it exists.
#' @param version   character  Conflict strategy:
#'   \describe{
#'     \item{none}{Append a timestamp only when a conflict is detected.}
#'     \item{timestamp}{Always append a timestamp.}
#'     \item{increment}{Append \code{_v1}, \code{_v2}, … on each conflict.}
#'   }
#' @return character  Normalised path (the file is NOT created by this function).
#' @export
safe_filename <- function(dir, basename, ext,
                          overwrite = FALSE,
                          version   = c("none", "timestamp", "increment")) {

  version <- match.arg(version)
  dir     <- as.character(dir)
  if (!dir.exists(dir)) dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  base <- sub("\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$", "", as.character(basename))
  path <- file.path(dir, paste0(base, ".", ext))

  if (!overwrite && file.exists(path)) {
    if (version == "none") {
      path <- file.path(dir,
                paste0(base, "_", format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"), ".", ext))

    } else if (version == "timestamp") {
      path <- file.path(dir,
                paste0(base, "_", format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S"), ".", ext))

    } else {                                                        # increment
      esc  <- gsub("([.\\^$*+?()[{\\\\|])", "\\\\\\1", base)
      pat  <- paste0("^", esc, "_v(\\d+)\\.", ext, "$")
      hits <- list.files(dir, pattern = pat)
      nv   <- if (length(hits)) {
        max(as.integer(
          sub(paste0("^", esc, "_v(\\d+)\\.", ext, "$"), "\\1", hits)
        ), na.rm = TRUE) + 1L
      } else 1L
      path <- file.path(dir, paste0(base, "_v", nv, ".", ext))
    }
  }

  normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}


# ── internal read / write ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

.read_one <- function(path, csv_read_args = list()) {
  ext <- .ext(path)
  switch(ext,
    rds = readRDS(path),
    csv = do.call(readr::read_csv,
                  c(list(file = path, show_col_types = FALSE), csv_read_args)),
    tsv = do.call(readr::read_tsv,
                  c(list(file = path, show_col_types = FALSE), csv_read_args)),
    stop("Cannot read format '.", ext, "'. Supported: rds, csv, tsv.", call. = FALSE)
  )
}

.write_one <- function(obj, path, csv_opts = list()) {
  ext <- .ext(path)
  .ensure_dir(path)

  switch(ext,

    rds = saveRDS(obj, file = path),

    csv = {
      if (!.is_flat(obj))
        stop(
          "Cannot save a <", class(obj)[1L], "> to CSV.\n",
          "  CSV and TSV support flat data.frames / tibbles only.\n",
          "  Use a .rds path for complex objects (DGEList, EList, lists, …).",
          call. = FALSE
        )
      do.call(readr::write_csv, c(list(x = obj, file = path), csv_opts))
    },

    tsv = {
      if (!.is_flat(obj))
        stop(
          "Cannot save a <", class(obj)[1L], "> to TSV.\n",
          "  CSV and TSV support flat data.frames / tibbles only.\n",
          "  Use a .rds path for complex objects (DGEList, EList, lists, …).",
          call. = FALSE
        )
      do.call(readr::write_tsv, c(list(x = obj, file = path), csv_opts))
    },

    stop("Cannot write format '.", ext, "'. Supported: rds, csv, tsv.", call. = FALSE)
  )

  message("  Saved : ", path)
}


# ── cache ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#' Cache any R object — load if cached, otherwise compute and save
#'
#' The extension of each path in \code{paths} determines the storage format:
#' \describe{
#'   \item{\code{.rds}}{Works for \emph{any} R object — DGEList, EList,
#'     list-of-lists, model fits, data.frames, …}
#'   \item{\code{.csv} / \code{.tsv}}{Flat data.frames / tibbles \emph{only}.
#'     Passing a complex object errors immediately with a clear message.}
#' }
#'
#' Multiple paths can be supplied; on a cache miss the object is written to
#' every format. On a cache hit the first existing file is read (preferring
#' \code{.rds} for round-trip fidelity).
#'
#' The compute block is only evaluated on a cache miss and can be supplied as:
#' \itemize{
#'   \item A bare \code{\{ \}} expression: \code{cache(path, \{ ... \})}
#'   \item A lambda / anonymous function:
#'         \code{cache(path, function() \{ ... \})} or
#'         \code{cache(path, \backslash()\{ ... \})} (R ≥ 4.1)
#' }
#'
#' @param paths         character vector  One or more output paths.
#' @param expr          Unevaluated \code{\{ block \}} or \code{function()}
#'                      whose last expression is the object to cache.
#' @param overwrite     logical  If TRUE always recompute and overwrite all paths.
#' @param verbose       logical  Emit messages on load / save.
#' @param csv_opts      list  Extra args forwarded to \code{readr::write_csv} /
#'                      \code{write_tsv}.
#' @param csv_read_args list  Extra args forwarded to \code{readr::read_csv} /
#'                      \code{read_tsv}.
#' @return The cached or freshly-computed object (invisibly).
#'
#' @examples
#' \dontrun{
#' ## ── DGEList / EList / any complex object ──────────────────────────────────
#' dat.voom_clean <- cache(
#'   make_path(project, "voom_clean", "rds", dirDataclean),
#'   {
#'     libs <- dat.voom$targets %>%
#'       subset(visit %notin% c("?", "Unknown")) %>%
#'       pull(libid)
#'     tmp <- dat.voom[, libs]
#'     tmp$targets <- tmp$targets %>%
#'       mutate(visit = ifelse(visit == "Screening/Enrollment", "Screening", visit)) %>%
#'       mutate(visit = factor(visit,
#'                levels = c("Screening", "Cold A Clinic", "Cold B Home", "Visit 1")))
#'     tmp
#'   }
#' )
#'
#' ## ── Same with a lambda ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#' dat.voom_clean <- cache(
#'   make_path(project, "voom_clean", "rds", dirDataclean),
#'   function() {
#'     ...
#'     tmp
#'   }
#' )
#'
#' ## ── Flat table → csv + rds simultaneously ─────────────────────────────────
#' results_tbl <- cache(
#'   make_path(project, "results", c("csv", "rds"), dirResults),
#'   { compute_results(dat.voom_clean) }
#' )
#'
#' ## ── List of lists ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#' model_fits <- cache(
#'   make_path(project, "model_fits", "rds", dirResults),
#'   { run_all_models(dat.voom_clean) }
#' )
#' }
#' @export
cache <- function(paths,
                  expr,
                  overwrite     = FALSE,
                  verbose       = TRUE,
                  csv_opts      = list(),
                  csv_read_args = list()) {

  paths <- as.character(paths)
  if (!length(paths))
    stop("`paths` must contain at least one file path.", call. = FALSE)

  exts <- .ext(paths)
  bad  <- setdiff(exts, c(.rds_exts, .table_exts))
  if (length(bad))
    stop("Unsupported extension(s) for cache(): ", paste0(".", bad, collapse = ", "),
         "\nFor figures use save_figures().", call. = FALSE)

  # ── Load (cache hit) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!overwrite) {
    rds_hit   <- paths[exts %in% .rds_exts & file.exists(paths)]
    any_hit   <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
    load_from <- if (length(rds_hit)) rds_hit[1L] else
                 if (length(any_hit)) any_hit[1L] else NULL

    if (!is.null(load_from)) {
      if (verbose) message("Loading cached: ", load_from)
      return(invisible(.read_one(load_from, csv_read_args)))
    }
  }

  # ── Compute (cache miss) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (verbose) message("Cache miss — computing ...")

  # Support both bare { } block and function() / \() lambda
  expr_sub <- substitute(expr)
  obj <- if (is.function(expr)) {
    expr()
  } else {
    eval(expr_sub, envir = parent.frame())
  }

  if (is.null(obj))
    warning("cache() expression returned NULL — nothing will be saved.", call. = FALSE)

  # ── Save to every requested path ────────────────────────────────────────────
  for (p in paths) .write_one(obj, p, csv_opts)

  invisible(obj)
}


# ── save_figures ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#' Save a ggplot / patchwork object to one or more files
#'
#' When \code{overwrite = FALSE} (the default), any output file that already
#' exists on disk is skipped — \code{ggsave} is not called for that path.
#' Set \code{overwrite = TRUE} to force re-rendering regardless.
#'
#' Supported extensions: \code{pdf}, \code{png}, \code{svg}, \code{eps},
#' \code{tiff}, \code{jpeg} / \code{jpg}.
#'
#' @param plot      A ggplot or patchwork object.
#' @param paths     character vector  One or more output paths.
#'                  Extension sets the device. Mix formats freely:
#'                  \code{c("Figs/pca.pdf", "Figs/pca.png")}
#' @param width     numeric  Plot width.
#' @param height    numeric  Plot height.
#' @param units     character \code{"in"} (default), \code{"cm"}, or \code{"mm"}.
#' @param dpi       numeric  Resolution for raster formats (default 300).
#' @param overwrite logical  If FALSE, skip paths whose file already exists.
#' @param verbose   logical  Emit a message for each file saved or skipped.
#' @param ...       Additional arguments forwarded to \code{ggplot2::ggsave()}.
#' @return Named list of output paths (invisibly), keyed by extension.
#'
#' @examples
#' \dontrun{
#' ## Single format
#' save_figures(p_pca,
#'              make_path(project, "pca", "pdf", dirFigs),
#'              width = 8, height = 6)
#'
#' ## Multiple formats in one call
#' save_figures(
#'   p_pca,
#'   paths = make_path(project, "pca", c("pdf", "png"), dirFigs),
#'   width  = 8, height = 6
#' )
#' }
#' @importFrom ggplot2 ggsave
#' @export
save_figures <- function(plot,
                         paths,
                         width     = NA,
                         height    = NA,
                         units     = "in",
                         dpi       = 300,
                         overwrite = FALSE,
                         verbose   = TRUE,
                         ...) {

  if (is.null(plot)) stop("`plot` is NULL.", call. = FALSE)
  paths <- as.character(paths)

  exts <- .ext(paths)
  bad  <- setdiff(exts, .figure_exts)
  if (length(bad))
    stop("Unsupported figure extension(s): ", paste0(".", bad, collapse = ", "),
         "\nSupported: ", paste0(".", .figure_exts, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)

  saved <- vector("list", length(paths))

  for (i in seq_along(paths)) {
    p <- paths[i]

    # ── Cache hit: skip ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (!overwrite && file.exists(p)) {
      if (verbose) message("  Figure exists (skipping): ", p)
      saved[[i]] <- p
      next
    }

    # ── Cache miss: render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    .ensure_dir(p)
    ggplot2::ggsave(
      filename = p,
      plot     = plot,
      device   = exts[i],
      width    = width,
      height   = height,
      units    = units,
      dpi      = dpi,
      ...
    )
    if (verbose) message("  Figure saved: ", p)
    saved[[i]] <- p
  }

  invisible(stats::setNames(saved, exts))
}


# ── cache_with_figures ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#' Cache data AND save figures in one call
#'
#' On a cache miss the compute block is evaluated once. The block must return
#' a named list:
#' \describe{
#'   \item{\code{$data}}{The object to cache (required).}
#'   \item{\code{$plot}}{A single ggplot / patchwork saved to all
#'     \code{figure_paths} (when \code{figure_paths} is a plain character
#'     vector).}
#'   \item{\code{$plots}}{A \emph{named} list of plots (when
#'     \code{figure_paths} is a named list keyed by plot name).}
#' }
#'
#' Figure caching follows \code{save_figures()} — existing figure files are
#' skipped when \code{overwrite = FALSE}.
#'
#' On a cache hit only the data is loaded. If you want to regenerate figures
#' on every run regardless, call \code{save_figures()} separately with
#' \code{overwrite = TRUE}.
#'
#' The compute block accepts both a bare \code{\{ \}} expression and a
#' \code{function()} / \code{\backslash()} lambda.
#'
#' @param data_paths    character vector  Paths for the data cache.
#' @param figure_paths  character vector \emph{or} named list.
#'   \itemize{
#'     \item Plain vector → \code{result$plot} saved to all paths.
#'     \item Named list   → each name matches a key in \code{result$plots};
#'           value is the character vector of paths for that plot.
#'   }
#' @param expr          Unevaluated \code{\{ block \}} or \code{function()}
#'                      returning \code{list(data = …, plot = …)}.
#' @param overwrite     logical  If TRUE recompute data and overwrite all files.
#'                      Figures are also re-rendered when TRUE.
#' @param verbose       logical
#' @param width,height,units,dpi  Forwarded to \code{save_figures()}.
#' @param csv_opts,csv_read_args  Forwarded to internal read/write helpers.
#' @param ...           Extra args forwarded to \code{ggplot2::ggsave()}.
#' @return The cached \code{$data} object (invisibly).
#'
#' @examples
#' \dontrun{
#' ## ── Single plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#' dat.voom_clean <- cache_with_figures(
#'   data_paths   = make_path(project, "voom_clean",  "rds",          dirDataclean),
#'   figure_paths = make_path(project, "pca",         c("pdf", "png"), dirFigs),
#'   width = 8, height = 6,
#'   {
#'     obj <- build_voom(dat.raw)
#'     list(data = obj, plot = plot_pca(obj))
#'   }
#' )
#'
#' ## ── Multiple plots (named list of figure_paths) ───────────────────────────
#' dat.voom_clean <- cache_with_figures(
#'   data_paths   = make_path(project, "voom_clean",  "rds",          dirDataclean),
#'   figure_paths = list(
#'     pca     = make_path(project, "pca",     c("pdf", "png"), dirFigs),
#'     heatmap = make_path(project, "heatmap", "pdf",           dirFigs)
#'   ),
#'   width = 8, height = 6,
#'   {
#'     obj <- build_voom(dat.raw)
#'     list(
#'       data  = obj,
#'       plots = list(
#'         pca     = plot_pca(obj),
#'         heatmap = plot_heatmap(obj)
#'       )
#'     )
#'   }
#' )
#'
#' ## ── Lambda syntax ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#' dat.voom_clean <- cache_with_figures(
#'   data_paths   = make_path(project, "voom_clean", "rds", dirDataclean),
#'   figure_paths = make_path(project, "pca",        "pdf", dirFigs),
#'   function() {
#'     obj <- build_voom(dat.raw)
#'     list(data = obj, plot = plot_pca(obj))
#'   }
#' )
#' }
#' @export
cache_with_figures <- function(data_paths,
                               figure_paths  = NULL,
                               expr,
                               overwrite     = FALSE,
                               verbose       = TRUE,
                               width         = NA,
                               height        = NA,
                               units         = "in",
                               dpi           = 300,
                               csv_opts      = list(),
                               csv_read_args = list(),
                               ...) {

  data_paths <- as.character(data_paths)

  # ── Cache hit: load data and return early ───────────────────────────────────
  if (!overwrite) {
    exts      <- .ext(data_paths)
    rds_hit   <- data_paths[exts %in% .rds_exts & file.exists(data_paths)]
    any_hit   <- data_paths[file.exists(data_paths)]
    load_from <- if (length(rds_hit)) rds_hit[1L] else
                 if (length(any_hit)) any_hit[1L] else NULL

    if (!is.null(load_from)) {
      if (verbose) message("Loading cached: ", load_from)
      return(invisible(.read_one(load_from, csv_read_args)))
    }
  }

  # ── Cache miss: compute ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (verbose) message("Cache miss — computing ...")

  expr_sub <- substitute(expr)
  result <- if (is.function(expr)) {
    expr()
  } else {
    eval(expr_sub, envir = parent.frame())
  }

  # ── Validate result structure ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.list(result) || !"data" %in% names(result))
    stop(
      "The expr block must return a named list with at least a `$data` element.\n",
      "  Bare block : list(data = my_obj, plot = my_plot)\n",
      "  Multi-plot : list(data = my_obj, plots = list(pca = p1, heatmap = p2))",
      call. = FALSE
    )

  obj <- result$data

  # ── Save data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  for (p in data_paths) .write_one(obj, p, csv_opts)

  # ── Save figures ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.null(figure_paths)) {

    if (is.list(figure_paths)) {
      # Named list: each name → a plot in result$plots
      if (!"plots" %in% names(result))
        stop(
          "figure_paths is a named list but the expr block returned no `$plots` element.\n",
          "  Return: list(data = …, plots = list(pca = p1, heatmap = p2))",
          call. = FALSE
        )
      for (nm in names(figure_paths)) {
        if (!nm %in% names(result$plots))
          stop("Plot '", nm, "' not found in result$plots. ",
               "Available: ", paste(names(result$plots), collapse = ", "),
               call. = FALSE)
        save_figures(
          result$plots[[nm]],
          paths     = as.character(figure_paths[[nm]]),
          width     = width, height = height, units = units, dpi = dpi,
          overwrite = overwrite, verbose = verbose, ...
        )
      }

    } else {
      # Plain vector: save result$plot (or first element of result$plots)
      plt <- result$plot %||% result$plots[[1L]]
      if (is.null(plt))
        stop(
          "figure_paths was supplied but the expr block returned neither ",
          "`$plot` nor `$plots`.\n",
          "  Return: list(data = …, plot = my_plot)",
          call. = FALSE
        )
      save_figures(
        plt,
        paths     = as.character(figure_paths),
        width     = width, height = height, units = units, dpi = dpi,
        overwrite = overwrite, verbose = verbose, ...
      )
    }
  }

  invisible(obj)
}
```

```{r test_load_utils}
# =============================================================================
# file_utils_examples.R
#
# Self-contained examples you can run top-to-bottom to verify file_utils.R

# needed, so it runs anywhere.
#

#source("file_utils.R")   # adjust path if needed

library(tibble)
library(dplyr)

dirResults   <- "Testing/Results"
dirFigs      <- "Testing/Figs"

# save_figures() — nothing to do here.

# 1.  make_path() — verify the naming convention
# =============================================================================

# Figure paths

# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
cat("\n── 4. save_figures() — pdf + png ───────────────────────────────────────\n")

p_scatter <- ggplot(results_tbl, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val))) +

)

# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
cat("\n── 5. cache_with_figures() — single plot ───────────────────────────────\n")

# The { } block is only evaluated on a cache miss.

clean_data <- cache_with_figures(

  figure_paths = make_path(project, "clean_pca",   c("pdf", "png"), dirFigs),

  }
)

cat("Loaded clean_data — rows:", nrow(clean_data), "\n")
print(clean_data)


# =============================================================================
# 6.  cache_with_figures() — data + MULTIPLE plots (named list)
# =============================================================================

multi_result <- cache_with_figures(
  data_paths   = make_path(project, "multi_analysis", "rds", dirResults),
  figure_paths = list(

    )

)

cat("Loaded multi_result — rows:", nrow(multi_result), "\n")


# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================

# Useful when the computation is defined elsewhere or you prefer the style.
make_summary <- function() {
  cat("  (computing summary via lambda ...)\n")
```

```{r}
# r
#' Create a safe filename in a directory (with optional versioning)
#'
#' Creates the directory if needed and returns a filepath that does not clobber
#' existing files unless overwrite = TRUE. Supports "none" (append timestamp on conflict),
#' "timestamp" (always add timestamp when conflict), and "increment" (append _vN).
#'
#' @param dir character Directory to save into.
#' @param basename character Base filename (extension will be removed if provided).
#' @param ext character File extension (without dot).
#' @param overwrite logical If TRUE, overwrite existing file.
#' @param version character One of "none", "timestamp", "increment".
#' @return character Normalized file path (not created yet).
#' @export
safe_filename <- function(dir, basename, ext, overwrite = FALSE, version = c("none", "timestamp", "increment")) {
  version <- match.arg(version)
  dir <- as.character(dir)
  if (!dir.exists(dir)) dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  base <- sub("\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$", "", as.character(basename))
  path <- file.path(dir, paste0(base, ".", ext))

  if (!overwrite && file.exists(path)) {
    if (version == "none") {
      ts <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
      path <- file.path(dir, paste0(base, "_", ts, ".", ext))
    } else if (version == "timestamp") {
      path <- file.path(dir, paste0(base, "_", format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S"), ".", ext))
    } else if (version == "increment") {
      # escape regex chars in base
      esc_base <- gsub("([.\\^$*+?()[{\\\\|])", "\\\\\\1", base)
      pattern <- paste0("^", esc_base, "_v(\\d+)\\.", ext, "$")
      existing <- list.files(dir, pattern = pattern)
      if (length(existing)) {
        nums <- as.integer(gsub(paste0("^", esc_base, "_v(\\d+)\\.", ext, "$"), "\\1", existing))
        next_v <- max(nums, na.rm = TRUE) + 1L
      } else {
        next_v <- 1L
      }
      path <- file.path(dir, paste0(base, "_v", next_v, ".", ext))
    }
  }

  normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}

#' Save a ggplot/patchwork object to one or more formats
#'
#' @param plot ggplot/patchwork object (required).
#' @param basename character Base filename (no extension).
#' @param dir character Directory to save plots into.
#' @param formats character Vector of formats, e.g. c("pdf","png").
#' @param width,height,units,dpi passed to ggplot2::ggsave.
#' @param overwrite logical If TRUE overwrite existing files.
#' @param version character Versioning strategy passed to safe_filename.
#' @param ... Additional args forwarded to ggplot2::ggsave.
#' @return named list of saved file paths (invisibly).
#' @importFrom ggplot2 ggsave
#' @export
save_plot <- function(plot, basename, dir = "Figs", formats = c("pdf", "png"),
                      units = "in", dpi = 300,
                      overwrite = FALSE, version = c("none", "timestamp", "increment"), ...) {
  if (is.null(plot)) stop("plot is NULL", call. = FALSE)
  version <- match.arg(version)
  saved <- list()
  for (fmt in formats) {
    path <- safe_filename(dir = dir, basename = basename, ext = fmt, overwrite = overwrite, version = version)
    ggplot2::ggsave(filename = path, plot = plot,
                    units = units, dpi = dpi, device = fmt, ...)
    saved[[fmt]] <- path
  }
  invisible(saved)
}

#' Save or Load a data.frame or tibble to csv/tsv/rds
#'
#' @param tbl data.frame or tibble (required).
#' @param basename character Base filename (no extension).
#' @param dir character Directory to save tables into.
#' @param formats character Vector of formats, e.g. c("csv","rds").
#' @param overwrite logical If TRUE overwrite existing files.
#' @param version character Versioning strategy passed to safe_filename.
#' @param csv_opts list Additional options forwarded to readr::write_csv/write_tsv.
#' @return named list of saved file paths (invisibly).
#' @importFrom readr write_csv write_tsv
#' @export
# r
# Save-or-load table: if overwrite = FALSE and load_if_exists = TRUE,
# existing files are read (and optionally assigned) without forcing tbl when tbl
# is an unbound symbol.
save_or_load_table <- function(tbl, basename, dir = "Results",
                               formats = c("csv", "rds"),
                               overwrite = FALSE,
                               version = c("none", "timestamp", "increment"),
                               csv_opts = list(),
                               load_if_exists = FALSE,
                               csv_read_args = list(),
                               assign_loaded = TRUE,
                               assign_env = parent.frame()) {
  version <- match.arg(version)
  dir <- as.character(dir)
  if (!dir.exists(dir)) dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # capture the expression the caller passed for tbl
  tbl_expr <- substitute(tbl)

  # derive a variable name to use when assigning loaded objects
  tbl_name <- if (is.symbol(tbl_expr)) {
    as.character(tbl_expr)
  } else if (is.character(tbl_expr) && length(tbl_expr) == 1L) {
    # literal string passed e.g. tbl = "myname"
    tbl_expr
  } else {
    # fallback to basename
    sub("\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$", "", as.character(basename))
  }

  # Try to evaluate tbl in caller safely; if evaluation errors, treat as "no value provided"
  tbl_value <- NULL
  eval_ok <- FALSE
  tbl_attempt <- try(eval(tbl_expr, envir = parent.frame()), silent = TRUE)
  if (!inherits(tbl_attempt, "try-error")) {
    # if caller passed a string literal, treat as name-only (no writing)
    if (is.character(tbl_attempt) && length(tbl_attempt) == 1L) {
      tbl_name <- tbl_attempt
      eval_ok <- FALSE
    } else if (is.data.frame(tbl_attempt) || tibble::is_tibble(tbl_attempt)) {
      tbl_value <- tbl_attempt
      eval_ok <- TRUE
    } else {
      # evaluated to something else -> error when user intended to write
      stop("`tbl` must be a data.frame/tibble when providing data to write", call. = FALSE)
    }
  } else {
    # evaluation failed (e.g. unbound symbol) -> treat as not provided
    eval_ok <- FALSE
  }

  will_write <- isTRUE(eval_ok)

  saved <- list()
  loaded <- list()
  base_name <- sub("\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$", "", as.character(basename))

  for (fmt in formats) {
    intended <- file.path(dir, paste0(base_name, ".", fmt))

    # If an existing file is present and caller asked to load instead of overwrite,
    # read it and (optionally) assign into caller's env, without forcing tbl_value.
    if (!overwrite && load_if_exists && file.exists(intended) && fmt %in% c("rds", "csv", "tsv")) {
      if (fmt == "rds") {
        obj <- readRDS(intended)
      } else if (fmt == "csv") {
        obj <- do.call(readr::read_csv, c(list(file = intended), csv_read_args))
      } else { # tsv
        obj <- do.call(readr::read_tsv, c(list(file = intended), csv_read_args))
      }
      saved[[fmt]] <- normalizePath(intended, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
      loaded[[fmt]] <- obj
      if (isTRUE(assign_loaded)) assign(tbl_name, obj, envir = assign_env)
      next
    }

    # Otherwise we must write — ensure we have data to write
    if (!will_write) {
      stop("No table object provided to write (tbl is missing or unbound). Set tbl to a data.frame/tibble or set load_if_exists = TRUE to read existing files.", call. = FALSE)
    }

    # determine safe target (versioning/overwrite handled)
    path <- safe_filename(dir = dir, basename = basename, ext = fmt, overwrite = overwrite, version = version)

    if (fmt == "csv") {
      do.call(readr::write_csv, c(list(x = tbl_value, file = path), csv_opts))
    } else if (fmt == "tsv") {
      do.call(readr::write_tsv, c(list(x = tbl_value, file = path), csv_opts))
    } else if (fmt == "rds") {
      saveRDS(tbl_value, file = path)
    } else {
      stop("unsupported table format: ", fmt, call. = FALSE)
    }

    saved[[fmt]] <- normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  }

  if (length(loaded) == 0L) {
    invisible(saved)
  } else {
    invisible(list(paths = saved, loaded = loaded))
  }
}

#' Save both plot and table (convenience wrapper)
#'
#' Calls save_plot() and/or save_or_load_table() and returns a list with $plots and $tables
#'
#' @param plot optional ggplot object
#' @param table optional data.frame/tibble
#' @param basename character Base filename
#' @param plot_dir,table_dir directories
#' @param plot_formats,table_formats format vectors
#' @param overwrite logical
#' @param version character Versioning strategy
#' @param plot_args list Additional args to pass to save_plot (will be spliced)
#' @param table_args list Additional args to pass to save_or_load_table (will be spliced)
#' @return list with elements $plots and/or $tables (invisibly)
#' @export
save_outputs <- function(plot = NULL, table = NULL, basename,
                         plot_dir = "Figs", table_dir = "Results",
                         plot_formats = c("pdf", "png"), table_formats = c("csv", "rds"),
                         overwrite = FALSE, version = c("none", "timestamp", "increment"),
                         plot_args = list(), table_args = list()) {
  version <- match.arg(version)
  results <- list()
  if (!is.null(plot)) {
    results$plots <- do.call(save_plot, c(list(plot = plot, basename = basename, dir = plot_dir,
                                                formats = plot_formats, overwrite = overwrite, version = version), plot_args))
  }
  if (!is.null(table)) {
    results$tables <- do.call(save_or_load_table, c(list(tbl = table, basename = basename, dir = table_dir,
                                                 formats = table_formats, overwrite = overwrite, version = version), table_args))
  }
  invisible(results)
}
```

```{r}
# r
# Utility helpers to save ggplot/patchwork objects and tabular results consistently.
# - save_plot(): saves ggplot/patchwork objects to one or more formats (pdf/png/svg).
# - save_or_load_table(): saves data.frames/tibbles to csv and/or rds.
# - save_outputs(): convenience wrapper to save both a plot and a table at once.
# Returns invisibly a named list of saved paths.

# R
safe_load_or_create <- function(file, create_fn, read_fn = readRDS, save_fn = saveRDS,
                                version = c("none","timestamp","increment"), overwrite = FALSE) {
  version <- match.arg(version)
  dir <- dirname(file)
  if (!dir.exists(dir)) dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE)
  if (file.exists(file) && !overwrite) {
    return(read_fn(file))
  }
  obj <- create_fn()
  if (is.null(obj)) stop("create_fn returned NULL")
  target <- file
  if (file.exists(file) && version != "none") {
    base <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)); ext <- tools::file_ext(file)
    if (version == "timestamp") target <- file.path(dir, paste0(base, "_", format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S"), ".", ext))
    else if (version == "increment") {
      existing <- list.files(dir, pattern = paste0("^", base, "_v\\d+\\.", ext, "$"))
      v <- if (length(existing)) max(as.integer(gsub(paste0("^", base, "_v(\\d+)\\.", ext, "$"), "\\1", existing)), na.rm = TRUE) + 1L else 1L
      target <- file.path(dir, paste0(base, "_v", v, ".", ext))
    }
  }
  tmp <- paste0(target, ".tmp")
  save_fn(obj, file = tmp)
  file.rename(tmp, target)
  attr(obj, "saved_to") <- normalizePath(target)
  obj
}

safe_filename <- function(dir, basename, ext, overwrite = FALSE) {
  dir <- as.character(dir)
  if (!dir.exists(dir)) dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  basename <- sub("\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$", "", basename) # remove ext if accidentally provided
  path <- file.path(dir, paste0(basename, ".", ext))
  if (!overwrite && file.exists(path)) {
    ts <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    path <- file.path(dir, paste0(basename, "_", ts, ".", ext))
  }
  path
}

save_plot <- function(plot, basename,
                      dir = if (exists("dirPlots")) dirPlots else "Figs",
                      formats = c("pdf", "png"),
                      width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300,
                      overwrite = FALSE, ...) {
  if (is.null(plot)) stop("plot is NULL")
  saved <- list()
  for (fmt in formats) {
    path <- safe_filename(dir, basename, fmt, overwrite = overwrite)
    # use ggplot2::ggsave which supports ggplot/patchwork objects
    ggplot2::ggsave(filename = path, plot = plot, width = width, height = height,
                    units = units, dpi = dpi, device = fmt, ...)
    saved[[fmt]] <- path
  }
  invisible(saved)
}

save_or_load_table <- function(tbl, basename,
                       dir = if (exists("dirresults")) dirresults else "Results",
                       formats = c("csv", "rds"),
                       overwrite = FALSE, csv_opts = list()) {
  if (!is.data.frame(tbl) && !tibble::is_tibble(tbl)) stop("tbl must be a data.frame or tibble")
  saved <- list()
  for (fmt in formats) {
    path <- safe_filename(dir, basename, fmt, overwrite = overwrite)
    if (fmt == "csv") {
      # pass additional options via csv_opts (e.g. na = "", delim = "\t")
      do.call(readr::write_csv, c(list(x = tbl, file = path), csv_opts))
    } else if (fmt == "tsv") {
      do.call(readr::write_tsv, c(list(x = tbl, file = path), csv_opts))
    } else if (fmt == "rds") {
      saveRDS(tbl, file = path)
    } else {
      stop("unsupported table format: ", fmt)
    }
    saved[[fmt]] <- path
  }
  invisible(saved)
}

save_outputs <- function(plot = NULL, table = NULL, basename,
                         plot_dir = if (exists("dirPlots")) dirPlots else "Figs",
                         table_dir = if (exists("dirresults")) dirresults else "Results",
                         plot_formats = c("pdf", "png"), table_formats = c("csv", "rds"),
                         overwrite = FALSE, plot_args = list(), table_args = list()) {
  results <- list()
  if (!is.null(plot)) {
    results$plots <- do.call(save_plot, c(list(plot = plot, basename = basename, dir = plot_dir,
                                                formats = plot_formats, overwrite = overwrite), plot_args))
  }
  if (!is.null(table)) {
    results$tables <- do.call(save_or_load_table, c(list(tbl = table, basename = basename, dir = table_dir,
                                                 formats = table_formats, overwrite = overwrite), table_args))
  }
  invisible(results)
}
```
